title: MV Presentation of "Capricoric Legends" and launch of the demo

posts.author: Zlormack
posts.body:
About my game "Capricone Legends":
My project is an RPG game based on the zodiac signs and their real characteristics. The player plays a Capricorn character born in January, who must face the other signs of the zodiac in symbolic duels. Each fight highlights the strengths and weaknesses specific to each sign, influenced by their element (Earth, Fire, Air, Water).
The ultimate goal is to find a Capricorn partner born in December, with whom the hero will form a powerful duo. The game will combine exploration, strategic combat, and a story mixing mystery and astrology.
What I have already realized:
Creation of maps (I use in particular the map "Ancient Ruins" for the demo)
Choice of sprites for my Capricorn character and my Aries enemy
Setting up a few simple events
My current difficulties:
Create a basic fight with a built-in tutorial
Display a clear explanatory message for the player before the fight
Manage experience gains at the end of the fight
If someone can direct me to simple tutorials or give me practical advice, it would be really great!
Why start with a demo?
As a beginner in video game development, I want to first create a simple and short demo version. This demo will allow me to:
Test the basic mechanics of the game (combat, exploration, dialogues)
Validate the balance of the fights according to the signs of the zodiac
Get feedback from players to improve gameplay and story
Fix bugs and learn to master RPG Maker MV little by little
Present my concept to the community and to future players, in order to create a craze around the project
This demo will therefore be a playable prototype serving as a solid basis before the development of the final, richer and more complex game.
Conclusion:
I am really motivated to move this project forward and learn along the way. All your advice, tutorials, resources or even experience sharing will be greatly appreciated! Do not hesitate to ask me questions if you want more details about the project.
Thank you very much in advance for your help and support!
